headline: Risk and Compliance Assistant (Public Sector)
summary: Risk and compliance assistant with three years at a coastal management authority in Pangasinan. I prepare risk reports, check that programs follow regulations and audit findings, research laws and rules for management, and keep compliance records and legal documents in order.
skills: Audit techniques and follow-up of findings

experience.title: Risk and Compliance Assistant
bullets: Prepare the quarterly risk register and report for the management committee.
Track audit findings and check that each office completes its corrective actions.
Research laws and rules on coastal use and tourism and summarise them for management.
Keep permits, contracts and compliance records complete and easy to retrieve.
Draft notices and endorsements for the legal officer's review.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
bullets: Processed visitor permits and filed documents.
Answered public enquiries at the front office.

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in Political Science
